description: This file defines the VariadicExpression class within the Twig templating engine, specifically under the Node\u00d6Expression namespace. It extends ArrayExpression to handle variadic (variable-length argument) expressions within Twig's expression parsing and compilation process.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\VariadicExpression
classes.description: Represents a variadic expression node in Twig's abstract syntax tree, used to compile variadic arguments in templates.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the variadic expression by outputting the '...' syntax followed by the parent class's compilation of arguments.
